fullText: you wake up in a crypt surrounded by the stench of death and failure congratulations you're a tarnished what's a tarnished you ask well imagine being so good at your job that the universe itself kicked you out of the lands between slapped a graceless sticker on your forehead and told you we'll call you when we need you but now for reasons unknown Grace has decided to swipe right on you a guide It's the greater Will's way of manipulating you into fixing its mess armed with a rusty sword a rickety shield and a questionable sense of purpose you set off into the world you're broke from bankruptcy he sells you a crafting kit and soap because even in the world of cosmic horror hygiene is important but before you can question why this guy's name sounds like a salad ingredient a software NPC energy spoiler she doesn't not yet yet anyway just when you're starting to get the hang of this whole wandering peasant in a death World thing Melina shows up again she's still mysterious and this time she offers you a deal take her to the air tree and she'll give you the ability to level up you agree partly because you're desperate for power and partly because why not just just look at that horse armed with your new Steed and a vague sense of purpose you follow the glowing rays of grace these act as your GPS leading you toward your first major objective storm Vil Castle along the way you encounter a mix of grow Tes monsters cryptic NPCs and the realization that they weren't kidding about being really into fingers storm Vil is a sprawling Fortress ruled by godric De grafted a demigod with an unhealthy Fascination for DIY limb enhancement as you fight your way through traps enemies and enough lore to fill a Wiki you begin to understand the stickes the Elden ring isn't just a shiny object it's the blueprint for reality itself shattered and Scattered among power hungry demigods when you finally confront godrick he does what any self-respecting megalomaniac would chops off his own arm and replaces it with a dragon's head because why not after a grilling battle you emerge Victorious you've taken your first great Rune A Shard of the Elden ring and it feels like the universe itself is Whispering not bad kid now do it five more times defeating godric is a turning point you're no longer just a clueless tarnish you're a tarnished with a purpose and that purpose to collect the great runes restore the Elden ring and deide the fate of the lands between but don't get cocky this is only the beginning and the lands between still has plenty of ways to Humble you with godric's defeat behind you you're feeling confident maybe too confident but the lands between isn't about to roll out a red carpet instead it's rolling out a parade of Horrors fire spewing chariots dragons with a vendetta and NPCs with more red flags than a toxic X as you venture out the true scill of the lands between hits you Lim grave was just a kitty po now you're diving into places like liia of the Lakes a vast expanse of water magic and regret here you meet the Academy of rehea lucaria the Academy's leader renala is a powerful sorceress with a tragic backstory and a knack for hurling Moon magic at your face beating her feels less like a victory and more like surviving an abusive physics class but it's not all doom and gloom along the way you start to gather allies or at least people who tolerate you Blade the wolf-headed warrior becomes your bro for life and then there's Ronnie the mysterious witch who offers you a quest line so convoluted it might as well come with a flowchart your primary Mission becomes clear collect all the great runes each is guarded by a demigod and each demigod has enough personal baggage to fill a therapy office radon the star scourage a giant warrior with gravity defying powers and a tragic backstory he's literally holding the stars in place his Festival of combat is less a battle and more a battle royale where everyone dies morgot The Omen King godric's less embarrassing relative who guards the capital with all the fervor of a mop on steroids reard Lord of blasphemy he fed himself to a giant snake because subtlety isn't in his vocabulary the lanes between is also full of characters who range from vaguely helpful to outright homicidal patches a recurring troll who alternates between robbing you and pretending to be your friend D Hunter of the Dead a grim figure with a grudge against anything Undead spoiler things don't end well for him FIA that bad companion she offers to hold you but drains your health in the process it's the most toxic relationship you'll ever agree to these characters add depth to the world but they also remind you that trust is a luxury you can't afford but hey you've got torrent a glowing Sword and the determination of someone who's died 200 times and keeps coming back for more what could possibly go wrong with a few great runes in your pocket and a growing list of demigod therapy bills in your wake you press forward starting to feel like a little more like someone who can actually get this Elden Lord gig done spoiler you're wrong the lands between isn't finished humbling you yet first on the chopping block star Scourge radon the biggest boy on the Block literally Ron is a walking mountain who somehow still rides his childhood Pony Leonard it's not cute it's tragic the Scarlet rot a gift from Millennia in their Clash has eroded his mind his body and most of his Common Sense leaving him a feral be Beast with gravity magic strong enough to hold the literal Stars hostage you're invited to the radon Festival which sounds fun until you realize Festival in the lands between is just code for suicide Packa Warriors from across the world have gathered not to fight with you but to create a chaotic distraction while you desperately Dodge meteors and figure out how to land a hit on bdon without becoming medieval roadkill afterward feels like hours of dying regrouping and questioning your life choices you finally take him down the stars resume their Celestial dance and you bask in the victory until you remember that you've only just started next up predor Reichard who apparently woke up one day and thought you know what would go great with my God complex a giant snake he fed himself to said snake transforming into a grotesque hybrid armed with a serpent Hunter spear that's literally what it's called you stab Dodge and cheese your way to Victory then there is morgot the omen King the capital's grumpy gatekeeper if godric was the embarrassing cousin everyone pretends doesn't exist morgot is the sibling who gets all the work done but never gets the appreciation his golden weaponry and Relentless aggression make him a tough opponent but you manag to take him down in true from software fashion his dying breath isn't gratitude or regret but pure unfiltered spite classic and then the walking biohazard melenia blade of Mela if Ron was a walking disaster melenia is an elegant apocalypse her H tree domain is a labyrinth of rot Despair and enemies designed solely to make you scream into a pillow she's got a move waterfoul dance that turns every fight into a high stakes guessing game of will I die instantly her Scarlet Rod infects the battlefield a reminder that even in defeat she takes you down with her after countless retries you emerge victorious she transforms into a giant flower and calmly reminds you that she is undefeated because she blooms again and again you're not sure whether to feel inspired or call it quits but as you pocket their great runes a question looms are you really fixing the world or are you just another Pawn in the greater Wills Cosmic game of Who Wants to be a puppet with the great runes in hand and your growing kill count making you the lands between least popular house guest the weight of your Journey Begins to settle but just as you think you're starting to make sense of this broken world the truth sucker punches you your next destination is the forge of the Giants a fiery hellscape where you're tasked with burning the air tree why because apparently you're Yul curated collection of great runes isn't enough to break the greater Will's grip you need to barbecue the sacred tree at the heart of the golden order's power but this isn't just a routine case of arson to like the forge someone has to sacrifice themselves enter Melina your cryptic travel companion in the closest thing you've got to a moral compass she offers to emulate herself and you're left with a choice let her go through with it or embrace the frenzied flame and burn the world your way but you start to wonder is this truly your choice or is it the greater will pulling the strings letting melanina go through with it feels like submitting to Destiny while embracing the frenzied flame is an act of rebellion so extreme it could torch the lands between and your very identity either way you decide whether to let this woman burn herself I hope you can live with yourself you need to know what it is to make the choice you say well the frenzied flame is an outer God that's basically the chaotic evil cousin of the greater will where the golden order wants to impose its rigid structure the frenzied flame offers Freedom by burning everything and everyone to AC but Freedom nonetheless if you choose to reject the flame and let Melina sacrifice herself the air tree burns and the golden order's influence begins to wne this clears the way for you to enter crumbling Pham Azula a floating ruin locked in Eternal storms here the mysteries of Destin death are revealed you face off against Malik the loyal guardian of the Rune of death who spent eon's keeping mortality under lock and key then comes the H tree long thought to be mela's failed Rebellion but is revealed to be more than just a sanctuary for the Cur and the Mis begotten it's part of his master plan to usurp the greater will entirely you uncover that mela's disappearance wasn't a simple kidnapping by MOG it was part of mela's scheme to manipulate his bloodthirsty half brother into advancing his own Ascension into godhood so MOG did beat the allegations mela's motives become clearer and darker he wasn't just building a paradise he was constructing a prison for free will using his abilities to bend others to his vision of perfection and you the tarnished have been unknowingly walking into his endgame as you piece together these Revelations one thing becomes painfully clear the greater will the Demi Gods the outer Gods They're all playing their own games and you the chess piece everyone wants to control even maica the enigmatic God who shattered the Elden ring begins to look less like a savior and more like a tragic tale you march toward the final showdown with the growing realization that this journey isn't just about restoring the Elden ring it's about deciding whose vision of the world deserves to win or if any of them do at this point you've burned the air tree acquired the Rune of death and left enough Carnage behind to make even the most hardened Warriors question your sanity but now as the lands between smolder and crack under your footsteps it's time to confront the final truths you make your way to the Ashen Capital former Lee lendal now buried under the weight of fire and ruin the Grandeur of the golden order is reduced to dust its Knights broken and its last Defenders little more than Shadows of their former s the first obstacle is Godfrey the first Elden Lord yes he's back and this time he's ditched the Regal golden daddy look for a full-on Primal Rage mode as horal L imagine your dad at a barbecue except instead of flipping burgers he's flipping you into the ground repeatedly while screaming about being the apex predator or maybe not if this gives War flashbacks for some of you turns out Godfree wasn't just maa's arm candy he was her Enforcer the OG Elden Lord who kept things in line before everything went sideways and what now he's here to remind you that he still got it defeating Godfrey clears the path to the air tree's heart where the shattered remains of MAA and her counterpart ragon await or should we say her other half because surprise Ma and ragon aren't just Partners they're two halves of the same being yep the greater will looked at the idea of self Crest and said perfect ship it and you're left think at least they aren't brother and sister like some other possible couple in this game d I'm kidding you're actually left thinking does this mean you've been fighting one God with severe identity issues or two Gods who can't decide who gets custody of the Elden ring I'm kidding again you don't really get the chance to think a lot before ragon starts hammering away at you ragon Furious and glowing with Divine energy unleashes his full power just as you start to think you've won the greater will pulls out its final card the Elden Beast a Celestial Nightmare made of stars divine order and your deepest insecurities the Elden Beast isn't just a fight it's the universe's final middle finger oh you think you're hot stuff because you made it this far meet my glowing space fish you realize this thing isn't just a boss it's the embodiment of the greater world's control but hey you didn't come this far to let a star powered Koon stop you so armed with sheer determination and maybe a healthy dose of Rage after dying 200 times to Millennia you landed the final blow congratulations you've officially ticked off the cosmos but your journey isn't over over with the Elden ring in Ruins and maa's Reign at the end you're presented with a choice or rather a series of moral dilemas disguised as endings number one age of fracture the default ending you slap the Elden ring back together like you're fixing a leaky faucet and become Elden Lord the golden order is restored the lands between size and relief and nothing fundamentally changes it's like cleaning up after a wild party everything looks fine but the smell lingers number two age of duskborn you followed FIA let her cuddle you and now you're fixing the death problem you use The Mending Rune of the death Prince to restart the Life Death cycle breaking the immortality curse it's peaceful it's poetic and it makes you wonder was all the murder really necessary yes yes it was number three blessing of Despair you aligned with the dung eater which says more about you than it does about the lands between The Mending Rune of the fail curse ensures the world is plunged into endless despair imagine being crowned King only to Doom your descendants to Eternal suffering though the modern equivalent would be just birthing a kid in this economy number four age of order by solving gold masks cryptic puzzles and completing brother Coran's quest line you unlock The Mending ruin of perfect order this ending Smooths out the inconsistencies of the golden order creating a world of peace and structure it's the neat freak dream no chaos no anomalies just orderly Harmony the lanes between gets a glow up and you get to feel smug about fixing what Ma broke just don't think too hard about how culty perfect order sounds number five Lord of frenzied flame burn it all no Gods no Kings just ashes Embrace chaos and become the physical embodiment of the frenzied flame ensuring that the world will never again be ruled by the Divine tyranny or anything else for that matter number six age of the Stars the Ronnie ending you ditch the greater will and the lands between entirely joining Ronnie in her quest to become a cosmic goddess it's the most romantic ending sure but also the most confusing do you rule the stars now are you a Celestial sidekick whatever it is you've officially ghosted the Landes between and that's it the world is broken again but hey at least it's not your problem anymore roll credits cuz you did it tarnished you either saved the lands between doomed it to Eternal suffering or yeed yourself into the cosmos with your blue doll wife either way your name will go down in history or at least in the angry RS of every NPC you accidentally killed along the way now go touch some grass literally the air trees ashes are everywhere
